description: Who moved in the app's own category chart: risers and fallers (3+ places), new entrants and drop-outs, with names, plus where the app itself and its chosen rivals stood on both days. The category comes from the app's chart record; pass genre to look at another. Pro plan.

country.description: country code, e.g. tr, us (defaults to the app's first country)

days.description: compare with this many days ago, 1-90 (default 1)

genre.description: App Store genre id, e.g. 6013 (defaults to the app's own category)

name: get_chart_movers
